name: Viracocha

domain_history.domain: creator deity and culture hero, credited with making all things including Inti; associated with pre-Inca as well as Inca peoples, presented in the mythology as older/more universal than the specifically Inca dynastic cult of Inti

notes: Contested internal hierarchy relative to Inti: sources disagree on whether Viracocha or Inti held primacy at different points in imperial history, and identification of the central figure on the Tiwanaku Gateway of the Sun is itself disputed between Inti and Viracocha — genuine ambiguity/shift in the tradition, not merely modern scholarly disagreement about one stable ancient fact. One tradition holds Viracocha's cult was specifically promoted by Pachacuti, possibly for political reasons.
